title: Fumed silica-based composite phase change materials with effective electric and magnetic heating abilities for wearable thermotherapy
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,11465-11477
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00438A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Giang Tien Nguyen, Lam Truong Nguyen, Nhung Tran Thi, Nguyen Thanh Nho, Le Thi Duy Hanh, Huynh Nguyen Anh Tuan, Thanh Vy Nguyen
A heat pad produced from PW/FS/EG@Fe3O4 composite shows a high thermal energy storage capacity. It can be effectively charged by an alternating magnetic field or a DC voltage and shows qualified performance in thermotherapy.
